tasks.description: Change the Surefire argLine in pom.xml to @{argLine} -javaagent:${org.mockito:mockito-core:jar} with an empty argLine property default, and confirm ./mvnw verify passes with no dynamic-agent warning

Run JaCoCo 0.8.15 (officially supports Java 26) prepare-agent, test, and report from the command line, confirm a report is produced for the existing classes, and record the command in claude-progress.txt

Add the Money record (long cents) with ZERO, ofCents, ofDollars (multiplyExact), and plus, minus, negate using Math.*Exact, with MoneyArithmeticTests for zero, ±1 cent, mixed signs, and overflow including negate of Long.MIN_VALUE

Add Comparable compareTo, instance min and max returning this on ties, isZero/isNegative/isPositive, and static sum(Collection) returning ZERO when empty, with tests for ties, signs, and empty, single, mixed, and overflowing collections

Add times(BigDecimal) per design §6.2 (ArithmeticException for a factor over 64 significant digits, exact multiply, ZERO when the leading-digit exponent is below -1, ArithmeticException above 18, HALF_EVEN setScale, longValueExact), with tests for 100 cents × .005/.015/.025 and negatives (0, 2, 2 and 0, -2, -2 cents), .0051, zero and negative factors, extreme exponents, guard edges (products of 0.1 and 0.09 cents, 1E18 and 1E19 cents, 64- and 65-digit factors), and overflow

Add toBareString and toDisplayString built from Long.toString(cents) with manual comma grouping, with MoneyFormattingTests for 0, 1, 10, 99, 100, 123456, 100000000, -1, -123456, Long.MAX_VALUE, and Long.MIN_VALUE under the default, de-DE, fr-FR, and ar-EG-u-nu-arab locales

Add MoneyFormatException extending IllegalArgumentException with a Reason enum (BLANK, TOO_LONG, INVALID_CHARACTER, MISSING_DIGITS, MISPLACED_SEPARATOR, TOO_MANY_DECIMALS, OUT_OF_RANGE), a reason() accessor, and one fixed message per reason that never includes the input, with tests in MoneyParsingTests

Add Money.parse as the single left-to-right scan in design §6.4 (null or blank, 32-character bound before strip, optional - then $, ASCII digits only, comma groups, one or two decimals, negative-side accumulation), with MoneyParsingTests for every accepted example and at least one rejected input per Reason asserting the message omits the input, plus pinned precedence cases: "1,23.456" MISPLACED_SEPARATOR, "$-5" INVALID_CHARACTER, 40 spaces TOO_LONG, "-" MISSING_DIGITS, "1.2,3" MISPLACED_SEPARATOR
Add round-trip tests that parse(m.toBareString()) and parse(m.toDisplayString()) equal m for 0, ±1, ±50, ±123456, Long.MAX_VALUE, Long.MIN_VALUE, and Long.MIN_VALUE + 1
Run ./mvnw verify and search Money.java, MoneyFormatException.java, and the three test classes for double, float, Double, and Float, confirming none appear
Measure JaCoCo line and branch coverage for Money and MoneyFormatException and add tests for any uncovered line or branch until both reach 100%, using JaCoCo 0.8.15 as in task 1.2
